summary.motive: Use the outside go as bait for a bailing corner and convert the inside stab into a climb that attacks the vacated seam between the coverage levels.
summary.keyDefender: Right Corner (bail technique with back to the slot)
summary.whyItWorks: The go route empties the entire right third, and the stab-to-climb conversion puts the slot in the one window no quarters defender owns once the corner turns and runs.
summary.failureMode: The corner plays with inside-eye discipline on No. 2 instead of bailing pure, squeezing the converted climb before it reaches the window.

beats.title: 1. The Go-and-Stab Stems
beats.text: Z releases pure vertical while Y builds toward a six-yard stab plant. The quarters corners bail reading their No. 1 receivers, exactly as the pre-snap look promised.

beats.title: 2. The Bail Read Trigger
beats.text: Y plants his stab and reads the corner: still bailing deep over the top of Z with his back turning. That bail is the trigger — the stab is now dead.

beats.title: 3. The Conversion Upfield
beats.text: Y converts off the plant and climbs into the void behind the bailing corner, working the seam the go route is emptying while the right-quarter safety sinks toward Z.

beats.title: 4. The Between-Levels Delivery
beats.text: The quarterback delivers between the sunk safety and the turned corner. The dig and drag below have stripped every underneath defender from the window.

relations.tell: The slot plants at six yards before accelerating — a called seam or vertical never breaks stride below eight.
